name: How much does it cost to build a backyard office?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a backyard office?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a backyard office varies significantly based on size, materials, level of customization, and included amenities like HVAC, plumbing, or advanced electrical work. A basic shed-style office might start around $15,000, while a fully insulated, custom-designed unit with utilities could range from $30,000 to $70,000 or more. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to understand your specific requirements and site conditions, ensuring transparency and no hidden costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs range from $15,000 for basic models to over $70,000 for custom units, depending on size, materials, and amenities. We provide detailed estimates after consultation.
